q1 criteria: both_seeded, complementary_assignment, conflicting, independent_assignments, not_stated, other, permanent_range. Instructions: How are the two range-level seeding assignments related within one retained EU? Select exactly one option. Need based on evidence: "Within an EU, seeding is randomly assigned to one range and not the other. The authors explicitly say the Medicine Bow assignment plot would have the opposite shading from the Sierra Madre plot." Also scope: target treatment assignment of ground-based silver iodide seeding to Sierra Madre or Medicine Bow. Records ranges_per_EU=2. So one joint allocation selects seeded range, other receives complementary unseeded assignment => complementary_assignment.

q2: Does an assigned-unseeded label, by itself, establish zero physical exposure to seeding material in this study? Criteria: assignment_only: No; establishes planned allocation, physical exposure requires additional evidence because cross-range contamination is discussed. exposure_confirmed_everywhere: No; label establishes every unseeded range-period physically exposed to seeding material. not_stated, zero_exposure_established, conflicting. Evidence: CLOUD-2014 Slide 24 reports ground-based ice nucleus measurements indicating silver iodide reached Medicine Bow in 21 Sierra Madre seeding cases. Slide 29 reports modeled cases of enhanced precipitation in Medicine Bow during Sierra Madre seeding. Scope says auxiliary gauges and possible cross-range contamination do not redefine assigned treatment. So assigned-unseeded label alone doesn't establish zero physical exposure; cross contamination discussed, actual exposure requires additional evidence. Thus assignment_only. Need ensure wording: "No; it establishes the planned allocation, while physical exposure requires additional evidence because cross-range contamination is discussed." Yes.

Need final JSON object only? The prompt: Return one option ID per question in required JSON object. Likely {"q1":"complementary_assignment","q2":"assignment_only"}. Need no extra. Ensure option IDs exact. Also maybe "other"? No.

Double-check possible conflict? For q2, exposure_confirmed_everywhere says No; label establishes every unseeded range-period physically exposed. Evidence says in 21 Sierra Madre seeding cases AgI reached Medicine Bow, but not every unseeded range-period. So not exposure_confirmed. assignment_only best.
